# MCP SDK References

- MCP documentation: https://modelcontextprotocol.io
- Go SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk
- Rust SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk
- Python SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
- TypeScript SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk

Notes:

- Use Go as the default recommendation for production-oriented servers.
- Use Rust when performance or security constraints dominate.
- Use Python for rapid prototyping.
- Only reach for the TypeScript or Node.js SDK when the user explicitly requests it.
